title: Response of wheat genotypes to zinc fertilization for improving productivity, profitability and grain biofortification
authors: Ghasal PC, Shivay YS, Pooniya V, Choudhary M, Verma RK
journal: Archives of Agronomy and Soil Science
notes: 6 wheat varieties (HD 2851, HD 2687, HD 2967, PBW 343, HD 2894, HD 2932) x 5 Zn treatments (Control, 5.0 kg Zn ZSHH, 2.5 kg Zn ZSHH + 0.5% FS, 2.5 kg Zn-EDTA, 1.25 kg Zn-EDTA + 0.5% FS), n=3, 2 years averaged. Grain Zn data is from Figure 2 (by variety) and Figure 3 (by treatment). Values estimated from bar charts. Figure 2 shows variety means across treatments; Figure 3 shows treatment means across varieties. Text states Zn application increased grain Zn concentration by 8-10%. Grain Zn values estimated from Figure 3 bar chart (averaged over 2 years and 6 varieties).
